facts.title: Learn Engineering
facts.note: No skill or level needed; teaches to skill 75. Buy a Blacksmith Hammer; most recipes need it.

facts.title: Journeyman Engineering
facts.note: Needs Engineering 50 and level 10; teaches to 150.

facts.title: Engineering 1-51: powder, bolts, Arclight Spanner
facts.note: 1-30: 60 Rough Blasting Powder (keep them). 30-50: 30 Handful of Copper Bolts (keep them). 50-51: Arclight Spanner (6 Copper Bar); it is a tool, keep it.

facts.title: Engineering 51-150: bombs, dynamite, bronze parts
facts.note: 51-75 Rough Copper Bomb (learn Journeyman first, they can take you past 75); 75-90 Coarse Blasting Powder; 90-100 Coarse Dynamite; 100-105 Silver Contact; 105-125 Bronze Tube (Weak Flux from the Engineering Supply vendor); 125-135 Standard Scope; 135-150 Heavy Blasting Powder and Whirring Bronze Gizmo, kept for 160.

facts.title: Expert Engineering
facts.note: Needs Engineering 125 and level 20; teaches to 225.
